description: A C# source file containing internal font helper functions for PDF processing in the PDFsharp library, including font measurement, typeface creation, checksum calculation, and glyph counting.

classes.name: FontHelper
classes.description: A static class providing internal font measurement, typeface creation, checksum calculation, and glyph counting functions for PDFsharp.

methods.name: MeasureString
methods.description: Measures the size of a string or code point glyph array using font data, returning width and height.

methods.name: CalcChecksum
methods.description: Calculates an Adler32 checksum combined with buffer length in a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CreateStyle
methods.description: Creates an XFontStyleEx value based on bold and italic boolean flags.

methods.name: CountGlyphs
methods.description: Counts the number of glyphs in a font by iterating over Unicode code points.
